items.memoText:
VETO MESSAGE - No. 238

TO THE ASSEMBLY:

I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill:

Assembly Bill Number 7261-A, entitled:

    "AN  ACT  to amend the executive law, in relation to Hurricane Sandy
      recovery funds oversight, and providing for  the  repeal  of  such
      provisions upon expiration thereof"

    NOT APPROVED

  This  bill  would require the Division of Budget (DOB), in conjunction
with the Office of the State Comptroller,  to  issue  an  annual  report
regarding  the  receipt,  distribution, and administration of Superstorm
Sandy recovery funding. It would also require DOB to develop  and  main-
tain a public website for the posting of such information.

  I  continue  to  vigilantly  enforce the State's efforts to distribute
Superstorm Sandy funds in a timely and efficient manner.  I  established
the  Governor's  Office  of Storm Recovery (GOSR), which, in conjunction
with the Department of Homeland Security and Emergency Services, already
makes information on the receipt, distribution,  and  administration  of
Superstorm  Sandy  funds  available  through  public reports and regular
updates to their respective websites. I also recently signed Chapter 413
of the Laws of 2014, which requires GOSR to publish quarterly reports on
the status of certain storm recovery applications. This bill is not only
duplicative of these reporting requirements, but also requires  DOB,  an
agency  that  is  not  directly  involved  in the administration of such
funds,  to  assume  new,  unfunded  responsibilities.  I  am   therefore
constrained to veto this bill.

  The bill is disapproved.                    (signed) ANDREW M. CUOMO
